verdict.rationale: Validating and auto-formatting configuration before planning is a fair question for an IaC tool, but the evidence pack documents no Pulumi validate or format command. Unit tests, Pulumi Policies and `pulumi preview` are related but different: they test code, enforce guardrails and act as the planning step itself. None of them validates or auto-formats configuration ahead of planning.

support.subject: As a developer, I can validate and auto-format my configuration before planning
